name: What steps are involved in working with a contractor like City Dweller, LLC for a rental bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in working with a contractor like City Dweller, LLC for a rental bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Working with City Dweller, LLC typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, budget, and property specific needs. We then provide a detailed proposal and scope of work. Once approved, we assist with material selection, secure necessary permits, and schedule the project. Our team manages all construction phases, conducts regular site visits, and communicates progress. The project concludes with a final walkthrough to ensure your satisfaction and adherence to all specifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial consultation, proposal, material selection, permitting, construction management with regular updates, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
